name: French in a Flash: Easy Pumpkin-Maple Breakfast Soufflés

ingredients.name: pure maple syrup, plus more for drizzling

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). In medium bowl, whisk together yolks, pumpkin, syrup, nutmeg, and pinch of salt until well combined.

In large clean bowl, whisk egg whites to soft peaks. Transfer heaping spoonful of whipped egg whites to the yolk mixture. Stir vigorously to incorporate. Then, pour the yolk mixture gently into whites, and fold gently with rubber spatula until just incorporated.

Pour soufflé batter into six 170 g ramekins on small rimmed baking sheet. Place in oven, and immediately reduce temperature to 175°C (350°F). Bake until puffed up and golden, 25 to 30 minutes. Serve immediately, with extra warm maple syrup on side.

schema_metadata.keywords: desserts, French in a Flash, holiday baking, souffles, thanksgiving

description: This is the easiest soufflé you'll ever make—just eggs, pumpkin, and syrup. After 30 minutes you have an impressive, effortless holiday breakfast with all the best flavors of Thanksgiving.
author: Kerry Saretsky
